title: Seat the MICKE desk end frame
task: attaching the second end frame to an IKEA MICKE desk
setting: Living-room floor with a round rug and hardwood. A light wood MICKE desktop lies upside-down; one white metal end/leg frame is already on the far short edge. A matching loose end frame, a small bag of fasteners, and a black bit/socket kit are used nearby amid a TV console, sofa, and guitar.

steps.text: Locate the loose end frame beside the desktop
steps.detail: Overhead view shows a white rectangular end frame lying on the round rug with the assembly area just beyond.
steps.expected: All parts (end frame + fasteners + driver kit) must be located and gathered together at the outset; locating only the frame is incomplete

steps.text: Pick up the second end frame
steps.detail: Hands lift the white end/leg frame while the wooden desktop rests on the floor with one end frame already fitted on the far side.
steps.expected: Picking up the end frame is correct only after fasteners and driver are already in hand; otherwise out of order

steps.text: Orient the mounting rail toward the free short end
steps.detail: The person holds the frame by its long sides so the holed mounting rail faces the open short edge of the desktop and steps into place.
steps.expected: Orientation of the mounting rail is correct only when screws and loaded driver are ready for immediate use

steps.text: Align and seat the end frame on the free short end
steps.detail: Kneeling over the panel, the person lines the white rail along the desktop edge and presses the frame down until it sits flush on the free short end.
steps.expected: Fasteners and driver must be prepared BEFORE any alignment or seating; seating the frame first is out of order

steps.text: Step around and confirm both end frames are placed
steps.detail: The assembler walks around the desk—now showing white end frames on both short sides—then moves toward hardware laid out on the floor.
steps.expected: Frames must be fastened before any confirmation walk-around; checking unsecured frames is premature and out of order

steps.text: Pick up the bag of fasteners
steps.detail: Both hands hold a clear plastic bag of screws and fittings with the partially assembled desk visible behind.
steps.expected: Fastener bag must be obtained and opened before the frame is ever picked up or oriented; retrieving it after seating is out of order

steps.detail: The person sets a black POKOT case on the rug and opens the lid to reveal rows of sockets and driver bits.
steps.expected: Driver kit must be opened and ready before frame orientation begins; opening it after seating is out of order

steps.text: Remove the liner and select a bit
steps.detail: A white insert is lifted out of the case and a hand reaches into the open tray to choose a driver bit for the fasteners.
steps.expected: Bit must be selected and loaded before alignment/seating so fastening can occur at once; selecting the bit after seating is out of order

afterClip: Drive the fasteners to lock both end frames to the desktop, then continue the remaining MICKE assembly steps from the manual.
procedure: Verify desktop is upside-down on protected surface with first end frame already securely fastened
Gather second end frame together with fastener bag and driver kit before any positioning
Open fastener bag, identify correct screws, open driver kit and seat matching bit in tool
Orient second end frame so mounting rail/holes face the free short edge of desktop
Align end-frame holes exactly with pre-drilled holes on free short end
Insert every screw through frame into desktop while holding alignment
Tighten all screws fully with driver until frame is flush and rigid
Confirm second end frame is secure and assembly stable before moving desk
